title: AtlasSeedEntry
description: Minimal record a human curator fills in manually. This is the input to LLM-assisted enrichment, not the final atlas record — see dataset.schema.json for that.

seed_id.description: Curator-assigned tracking key for this seed row, unique within a search_batch (e.g. row number or short slug). Not the final atlas_id.

source_type.description: DATASET = deposited data with an accession (GEO/ArrayExpress/etc). PAPER = a publication describing autoantibody results with no independently browsable dataset.

search_batch.description: Free-text label for the curation search/source that surfaced this entry (e.g. 'GEO search 1', 'HuProt website', 'author contact'). Kept for provenance, not parsed.

identifier.description: Best known accession, DOI, or PMID for this entry, as found by the curator (e.g. GSE12345). May be approximate — the enrichment step verifies it.

link.description: URL to the dataset landing page or the publication, as found by the curator.

curator_notes.description: Free-text notes from the curator (e.g. why it's relevant, anything unusual).

curator.description: Name or email of the person who added this seed entry.
